snippet.title: Meet the victims - OXIDE ROOM 208
snippet.description: In #oxideroom208, you'll have access to 8+1 digitized flesh-and-blood characters, allowing you to experience the #horror and agony of their final moments in this GRUESOME #bodyhorror packed with action, blood and  guts. How many will you be able to save?
